analysis_draft.title: W03 Derivative URL-String Analysis v1.1: Prospective Three-Series Amendment (DRAFT)

description: Prospective DRAFT for a three-lineage first-party API Core Interface (ACI), limited to OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude and Google/Gemini, with two-other-family reciprocal AI coding and common Core-specific calibration. The owner selected W03 (1 December 2026) as the effective wave and new STD baseline, excluded W02 from current primary comparisons, prohibited automatic baseline replacement and approved separate W04 calibration. The frozen 24 query forms, k=10, original calendar and retry rules are retained: 720 ordinary / 840 calibration initial requests; W03 I03 has 60 intended slots. Historical four-lineage records are preserved. Operational rating admission is distinct from independent-reference validation. Unreferenced AI codes are auxiliary/exploratory; undefined metrics and H variables remain held. The fixed qualification criteria do not establish completed content review, empirical validation or human validity. The deterministic URL primary analysis does not require AI qualification. Public registration, exact private freezes, actual calibration and execution authorization remain incomplete.
